item.title: [翻译] TLDR AI: Kimi K2.6 发布、Codex Chronicle 上线、贝佐斯百亿 AI 融资
item.description:
标签: #大模型 #智能体 #融资 #编程

摘要: 本期简报聚焦Moonshot AI发布Kimi K2.6系列模型并宣称在编码与智能体基准上超越GPT-5.4等对手，OpenAI为Codex推出基于屏幕上下文的Chronicle记忆功能，以及贝佐斯旗下AI实验室Project Prometheus即将完成100亿美元融资；同时涵盖Meta、Google及微软在训练效率、多代理系统和Copilot计费策略方面的最新行业动向。

原标题: Kimi K2.6 🚀, Codex Chronicle 🤖, Bezos’ $10B AI fundraise 💰

TLDR AI 2026-04-21

Kimi K2.6 🚀, Codex Chronicle 🤖, Bezos’ $10B AI fundraise 💰

Chronicle – Codex (6 minute read)

Chronicle, available for ChatGPT Pro users on macOS, augments Codex by using screen context for memory building, helping Codex understand ongoing work with less context restatement. It stores unencrypted markdown memories on your device and requires macOS Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions. Be aware of prompt injection risks from screen content, and pause Chronicle during sensitive work to prevent unwanted context capture.

Chronicle 现面向 macOS 上的 ChatGPT Pro 用户开放，它通过利用屏幕上下文构建记忆来增强 Codex，帮助 Codex 在无需反复重述上下文的情况下理解正在进行的工作。该功能将未加密的 markdown 记忆存储在本地设备上，并需要 macOS 的屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。需注意屏幕内容带来的 提示注入（prompt injection） 风险，在处理敏感工作时应暂停 Chronicle，以防止捕获不必要的上下文。

Moonshot AI launches Kimi K2.6 on Kimi Chat and APIs (2 minute read)

Moonshot AI launches Kimi K2.6, which features robust capabilities for coding and agentic tasks across chat and agent modes on kimi.com, with weights on Hugging Face and APIs via platform.moonshot.ai. The lineup includes K2.6 Instant for quick replies, K2.6 Thinking for complex reasoning, K2.6 Agent for document and web tasks, and K2.6 Agent Swarm for large-scale processing. Kimi K2.6 claims top open-source benchmark scores, surpassing competitors like GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 in SWE-bench Multilingual and BrowseComp.

Moonshot AI 发布 Kimi K2.6，该模型在 kimi.com 的聊天和 Agent 模式下均具备强大的编程和 智能体（agentic） 任务处理能力，模型权重已发布在 Hugging Face，API 可通过 platform.moonshot.ai 调用。该系列包括用于快速回复的 K2.6 Instant、用于复杂推理的 K2.6 Thinking、用于文档和网页任务的 K2.6 Agent，以及用于大规模处理的 K2.6 Agent Swarm。Kimi K2.6 宣称在开源基准测试中取得顶尖成绩，在 SWE-bench Multilingual 和 BrowseComp 等测试中超越了 GPT-5.4 和 Claude Opus 4.6 等竞争对手。

Qwen3.6-Max-Preview: Smarter, Sharper, Still Evolving (2 minute read)

Qwen3.6-Max-Preview brings stronger world knowledge and instruction following along with significant agentic coding improvements across a wide range of benchmarks. The model is still under active development as researchers continue to iterate on it. Users can chat with the model interactively in Qwen Studio or call via API on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API (coming soon).

Qwen3.6-Max-Preview 在广泛基准测试中展现出更强的世界知识、指令遵循能力以及显著的 智能体编程（agentic coding） 改进。该模型仍在积极开发中，研究人员正在持续迭代。用户可在 Qwen Studio 中与模型交互式对话，或通过 阿里云（Alibaba Cloud） Model Studio API 调用（即将推出）。

Jeff Bezos Nears $10 Billion Funding for AI Lab, FT Says (2 minute read)

Jeff Bezos' AI startup, which is aiming to develop models with the capability of understanding the physical world, is close to finalizing a $10 billion funding round. The company, code-named Project Prometheus, will use AI to accelerate engineering and manufacturing in fields like aerospace and automobiles. It was set up with an initial $6.2 billion in funding, sourced in part by Bezos himself. The new funding round, which is expected to close soon but has not been finalized, will include JPMorgan and BlackRock as investors.

据《金融时报》（FT）报道，杰夫·贝索斯（Jeff Bezos）旗下的 AI 初创公司接近完成一轮 100 亿美元融资，该公司旨在开发具备理解物理世界能力的模型。这家代号为 Project Prometheus 的企业将利用 AI 加速航空航天和汽车制造等领域的工程与生产。公司最初获得了 62 亿美元融资，部分由贝索斯本人出资。新一轮融资预计很快完成但尚未最终敲定，投资方将包括 摩根大通（JPMorgan）和 贝莱德（BlackRock）。

Improving Training Efficiency with Effective Training Time (19 minute read)

Meta introduced Effective Training Time (ETT%) to measure how much end-to-end training runtime is spent on actual learning, highlighting overhead like checkpointing and failures. This post outlines system and PyTorch-level optimizations that reduce wasted time and improve large-scale training efficiency.

Meta 引入了有效训练时间（Effective Training Time, ETT%）这一指标，用于衡量端到端训练运行时间中有多少被用于实际学习，并揭示了 检查点（checkpointing） 和故障等开销。本文介绍了系统层面及 PyTorch 层面的优化措施，以减少时间浪费并提升大规模训练效率。

Modular Post-Training (14 minute read)

AllenAI describes a post-training approach that builds independent domain experts and combines them using a mixture-of-experts architecture. This allows models to gain new capabilities without retraining from scratch or degrading existing skills.

AllenAI 介绍了一种 后训练（post-training） 方法，该方法构建独立的领域专家，并通过 混合专家（mixture-of-experts, MoE） 架构将其组合。这使模型无需从头重新训练或损害现有技能即可获得新能力。

Even 'uncensored' models can't say what they want (6 minute read)

Even uncensored models quietly nudge language away from the words that sentences actually want. There is no refusal or warning - the probability just moves in some instances. This is a mechanism that can be used to shape what billions of users read without them noticing.

即使是未经审查的模型（uncensored models），也会悄悄地将语言从句子真正想要表达的词汇上引开。没有拒绝，也没有警告——在某些情况下，概率（probability） 只是发生了偏移。这是一种可用于塑造数十亿用户阅读内容的机制，而用户却浑然不觉。

👨‍💻

Engineering & Research

Multi-agent systems that survive production (Sponsor)

Google adds subagents to Gemini CLI to handle parallel coding tasks (4 minute read)

Google's Gemini CLI now includes subagents to split coding tasks, enhancing parallel execution by delegating specific roles like frontend updates or testing. This enables multiple tasks to process simultaneously without interference, optimizing workflows for developers. Gemini's setup contrasts with systems like Claude Code, which extends agent coordination across multiple sessions.

Google 的 Gemini CLI 现新增了 子代理（subagents） 功能以拆分编码任务，通过委派前端更新或测试等特定角色来增强 并行执行（parallel execution） 能力。这使得多个任务能够同时处理且互不干扰，从而优化开发者的工作流。Gemini 的方案与 Claude Code 等系统形成对比，后者将智能体协作扩展到了多个会话之间。

Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report (32 minute read)

Qwen3.5-Omni scales to hundreds of billions of parameters with a hybrid MoE architecture, supporting long-context multimodal inputs across text, audio, and video.

Qwen3.5-Omni 采用混合 MoE（混合专家） 架构，参数规模扩展至数千亿，支持文本、音频和视频的长上下文 多模态（multimodal） 输入。

DeepMind's TIPSv2 Vision-Language Encoder (6 minute read)

DeepMind's TIPSv2 improves vision-language pretraining by combining distillation, enhanced self-supervised objectives, and richer caption data. The resulting models achieve strong performance across multimodal tasks, with notable gains in zero-shot segmentation.

DeepMind 提出的 TIPSv2 通过结合蒸馏、增强的自监督目标和更丰富的字幕数据，改进了视觉-语言预训练。由此得到的模型在多模态任务中表现强劲，在 零样本分割（zero-shot segmentation） 方面取得了显著增益。

FlashDrive: Flash Vision-Language-Action Inference For Autonomous Driving (8 minute read)

FlashDrive is an algorithm-system co-design framework that reduces end-to-end latency to 159ms with negligible accuracy loss. VLA inference is a cascade of stages, each hiding a different form of redundancy. Temporal overlap in vision, low entropy in reasoning, velocity smoothness in flow matching, and numerical headroom in weights each yield to a targeted shortcut. The speedups compound to 4.5x with negligible accuracy loss because the redundancies are orthogonal.

FlashDrive 是一种算法与系统协同设计的框架，可将 端到端延迟（end-to-end latency） 降至 159 毫秒，且精度损失可忽略不计。VLA（视觉-语言-动作，Vision-Language-Action） 推理是一个多阶段级联，每个阶段都隐藏着不同形式的冗余。视觉中的时间重叠、推理中的低熵、流匹配（flow matching）中的速度平滑性，以及权重中的数值余量，各自都可通过针对性的捷径消除。由于这些冗余相互正交，加速效果累积可达 4.5 倍，且精度损失可忽略不计。

OpenAI Stargate: where the US sites stand (9 minute read)

The US is in the model of an unprecedented build-out of AI infrastructure. Stargate is a $500 billion endeavor that involves OpenAI, Oracle, and SoftBank. The AI infrastructure project has seven locations across the US that are currently showing active development. They currently add up to over 9 gigawatts of planned capacity, enough to power the equivalent of 20 million Nvidia H100 GPUs - the total amount of AI compute in the world at the end of 2025. This post takes a look at each of the sites and how they are currently being developed.

美国正处于一场前所未有的 AI 基础设施（AI infrastructure） 建设之中。Stargate 是一项耗资 5000 亿美元的计划，涉及 OpenAI、Oracle（甲骨文） 和 SoftBank（软银）。该 AI 基础设施项目在美国有七个地点正在积极开发中。这些地点目前的计划总容量超过 9 吉瓦（gigawatts），足以驱动相当于 2000 万块 英伟达（Nvidia） H100 GPU 的算力——这相当于 2025 年底全球 AI 计算能力的总量。本文逐一介绍了各个地点及其当前开发状况。

Microsoft To Shift GitHub Copilot Users To Token-Based Billing, Tighten Rate Limits (4 minute read)

Microsoft plans to temporarily suspend individual account signups to GitHub Copilot. The weekly cost of running the service has doubled since the start of the year. Microsoft intends to tighten rate limits on individual and business accounts. It will also remove access to certain models for those with the cheapest subscriptions.

微软（Microsoft） 计划暂时停止 GitHub Copilot 的个人账号注册，并将用户转向基于 Token 的计费模式。自年初以来，该服务的每周运营成本已翻倍。微软打算对个人和企业账户收紧 速率限制（rate limits），并将取消最低档订阅用户对某些模型的访问权限。

item.title: [翻译] Latent Space: Moonshot Kimi K2.6：全球顶尖开源模型刷新性能，紧追Opus 4.6
item.description:
标签: #Kimi #开源模型 #智能体 #代码生成

摘要: Moonshot发布开源权重模型Kimi K2.6，凭借在代码、工具使用等多维度基准上的亮眼表现及支持超长程自主运行的强化智能体架构，进一步缩小了与顶级闭源模型的差距；结合通义千问等中国实验室的密集迭代，开源生态在AI编程与多智能体协作领域的竞争格局正显著升温。

原标题: [AINews] Moonshot Kimi K2.6: the world's leading Open Model refreshes to catch up to Opus 4.6 (ahead of DeepSeek v4?)

Two days left before Early Bird ends for AI Engineer World’s Fair this Summer in SF. This is will be THE BIG ONE of the year - lock in discounts up to $500 (refundable).

距离今夏在旧金山举办的 AI Engineer World’s Fair 早鸟票截止仅剩两天。这将是今年最盛大的活动——锁定最高 500 美元的折扣（可退款）。

DeepSeek V4 rumors are back, and we learned our lesson not to get too excited, but in their deafening silence since v3.2, Moonshot has owned the crown of leading Chinese open model lab for all of 2026 to date, and K2.6 refreshes the lead that K2.5 established in January, with (presumably) more continued pre/posttraining (this time, details of how much more training were not disclosed). Comparing the numbers from the two launches 3 months apart demonstrates the staggering amount of progress:

DeepSeek V4 的传闻再度出现，我们也吸取了教训不再过度兴奋，但在 DeepSeek v3.2 之后令人窒息的沉默中，Moonshot 至今仍是 2026 年以来无可争议的中国领先开放模型实验室，而 K2.6 进一步巩固了 K2.5 在一月建立的优势，推测进行了更多持续的预训练/后训练（但此次未披露具体增加了多少训练量）。对比相隔三个月发布的两组数据，进步之大令人震惊：

Moonshot/Kimi continues to compete at a level far above “just being open source versions of Frontier models” (though it is one of the three Chinese labs accused by Anthropic in Feb) - they are taking on Gemini 3.1 in their home turf of frontend design, touting a 68.6% win+tie rate vs Gemini 3.1 Pro:

Moonshot/Kimi 的竞争水平早已远超“仅仅是前沿模型的开源版本”（尽管它正是 Anthropic 在二月点名指控的三家中国实验室之一）——它们正直面 Gemini 3.1 的前端设计主场优势，并宣称对阵 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的胜+平率达到 68.6%：

And scaling out the pioneering work they did with Agent Swarm RL last edition:

并且在上个版本中基于 Agent Swarm RL（智能体集群强化学习）的开创性工作基础上进行了扩展：

And, with OpenClaw being the flavor of the quarter, their own ClawBench and a minor rebrand of their Agent Swarm work in to "Claw Groups”.

此外，随着 OpenClaw 成为本季度热门，他们也推出了自己的 ClawBench，并将 Agent Swarm 工作小幅重新品牌化为“Claw Groups”。

Overall not a technically impressive in isolation as K2.5, but overall still showing far more execution and imagination and drive than their peers, an impressive update and incredible gift to the ecosystem.

总体而言，单论技术突破不如 K2.5 那么令人瞩目，但整体上仍展现出远超同行的执行力、想象力与进取心，是一次令人印象深刻的更新，也是对生态系统的巨大贡献。

Kimi K2.6 and Qwen3.6-Max-Preview Push Open Agentic Coding Forward

Kimi K2.6 与 Qwen3.6-Max-Preview 推动开放式智能编码前行

  • Moonshot’s Kimi K2.6 was the clear release of the day: an open-weight 1T-parameter MoE with 32B active, 384 experts (8 routed + 1 shared), MLA attention, 256K context, native multimodality, and INT4 quantization, with day-0 support in vLLM, OpenRouter, Cloudflare Workers AI, Baseten, MLX, Hermes Agent, and OpenCode. Moonshot claims open-source SOTA on HLE w/ tools 54.0, SWE-Bench Pro 58.6, SWE-bench Multilingual 76.7, BrowseComp 83.2, Toolathlon 50.0, CharXiv w/ python 86.7, and Math Vision w/ python 93.2 in the launch thread. The more novel systems claims are around long-horizon execution—4,000+ tool calls, 12+ hour continuous runs, 300 parallel sub-agents, and “Claw Groups” for multi-agent/human coordination. Community reactions quickly centered on K2.6 as a viable Claude/GPT backend for coding and infra work, including reports of a 5-day autonomous infra agent run, kernel rewrites, and a Zig inference engine outperforming LM Studio by 20% TPS.

Moonshot 的 Kimi K2.6 无疑是当日最重磅的发布：一款开放权重的 1T 参数 MoE（Mixture of Experts，混合专家）模型，激活参数 32B，拥有 384 个专家（8 个路由 + 1 个共享），采用 MLA（Multi-head Latent Attention，多头潜在注意力）注意力机制，支持 256K 上下文，原生多模态，并支持 INT4 quantization（4 位整数量化）。发布首日即获 vLLM、OpenRouter、Cloudflare Workers AI、Baseten、MLX、Hermes Agent 和 OpenCode 支持。Moonshot 在发布线程中宣称其在多个基准上达到开源 SOTA（state-of-the-art，最优水平）：HLE w/ tools 54.0、SWE-Bench Pro 58.6、SWE-bench Multilingual 76.7、BrowseComp 83.2、Toolathlon 50.0、CharXiv w/ python 86.7、Math Vision w/ python 93.2。更具新意的是系统在长程执行（long-horizon execution）上的能力——支持 4,000+ 次工具调用、12 小时以上连续运行、300 个并行子代理，以及用于多代理/人类协作的“Claw Groups”。社区反响迅速聚焦于 K2.6 作为编码和基础设施工作中可行的 Claude/GPT 替代后端，包括报告称它完成了长达 5 天的自主基础设施代理运行、内核重写，以及一款 Zig 推理引擎在 TPS 上比 LM Studio 高出 20%。

阿里巴巴的 Qwen3.6-Max-Preview 也作为下一代旗舰模型的早期预览登场，在智能编码（agentic coding）、世界知识和指令遵循方面均有提升，据 @Alibaba_Qwen 称其在“现实世界代理和知识可靠性”上表现更佳。早期社区反馈认为它在长推理任务中异常稳定；@teortaxesTex 指出它经过约 30 分钟的思考后解出了 AIME 2026 #15，随后 Arena 也注意到 Qwen3.6 Plus 在 Code Arena 中升至第 7 名，并将阿里巴巴推至该榜单实验室第 3 位。Kimi 和 Qwen 共同印证了一个更宏大的趋势：中国开放及半开放实验室正在推出极具竞争力的编程/代理模型，并迅速获得生态采纳。

阿里巴巴的 Qwen3.6-Max-Preview 也作为下一代旗舰模型的早期预览登场，在智能编码、世界知识和指令遵循方面均有提升，据 @Alibaba_Qwen 称其在“现实世界代理和知识可靠性”上表现更佳。早期社区反馈认为它在长推理任务中异常稳定；@teortaxesTex 指出它经过约 30 分钟的思考后解出了 AIME 2026 #15，随后 Arena 也注意到 Qwen3.6 Plus 在 Code Arena 中升至第 7 名，并将阿里巴巴推至该榜单实验室第 3 位。Kimi 和 Qwen 共同印证了一个更宏大的趋势：中国开放及半开放实验室正在推出极具竞争力的编程/代理模型，并迅速获得生态采纳。

Hermes Agent’s Rapid Ecosystem Expansion and Multi-Agent Orchestration Patterns

Hermes Agent 的快速生态扩张与多智能体编排模式

  • Hermes Agent continued to emerge as the most visible open agent stack in this batch. Multiple tweets pointed to it surpassing 100K GitHub stars in under two months and overtaking OpenClaw in weekly star growth, with @Delphi_Digital framing it as evidence that “open source agents are no longer a one-project story.” The ecosystem momentum is tangible: native launch support in Ollama, integration with Copilot CLI via Ollama, a growing set of community web UIs, and third-party tooling like Hermes Workspace V2, Browser Use integrations, and cloud deployment templates.

Hermes Agent 继续成为本批中最受瞩目的开放智能体技术栈。多条推文指出它在不到两个月内突破 10 万 GitHub Star，并在周增速上超越 OpenClaw；@Delphi_Digital 将其视为“开源智能体不再只是单项目叙事”的证据。生态动量清晰可见：原生支持 Ollama 上线、通过 Ollama 集成 Copilot CLI、不断增长的社区 Web UI，以及 Hermes Workspace V2、Browser Use 集成和云部署模板等第三方工具。

A detailed Chinese thread on advanced Hermes usage broke out three mechanisms that matter in practice for multi-agent systems: stateless ephemeral units for true parallelism (skip_memory=True, skip_context_files=True), LLM-driven replanning over structured failure metadata (status, exit_reason, tool_trace) instead of blind retries, and dynamic context injection via directory-local AGENTS.md/.cursorrules surfaced only through tool results. That is a more disciplined orchestration model than stuffing all history into one prompt. Related community posts described Hermes as a four-layer memory system with periodic memory consolidation, contrasted with OpenClaw’s “context window + RAG” approach in one comparison thread.

更具实质内容的是操作者模式（operator patterns）。一篇详细的中文线程剖析了高级 Hermes 用法中，对多智能体系统至关重要的三种机制：无状态短暂单元（stateless ephemeral units）实现真正的并行（skip_memory=True, skip_context_files=True）；基于结构化失败元数据（status, exit_reason, tool_trace）的 LLM 驱动重规划（LLM-driven replanning），而非盲目重试；以及通过目录本地 AGENTS.md/.cursorrules 仅在工具结果中浮现的动态上下文注入。这是一种比将所有历史塞入单个提示词更严谨的编排模型。相关社区帖子将 Hermes 描述为具有周期性记忆整合的四层记忆系统，并在一篇对比线程中将其与 OpenClaw 的“上下文窗口 + RAG”方法进行了对比。

Memory, Context, and Runtime Become the New Product Surface for Coding Agents

记忆、上下文与运行时成为编码智能体的新产品战场

  • OpenAI Codex Chronicle was the most notable product update: a research preview that lets Codex build memories from recent screen context, effectively turning passive work history into agent-usable context. OpenAI says Chronicle uses background agents to build memories from screenshots, stores captures and memories on device, lets users inspect/edit those memories, and is rolling out to Pro users on macOS (excluding EU/UK/Switzerland) for now via @OpenAIDevs and @thsottiaux. This is a meaningful shift from chat history as memory to ambient context capture, and several builders immediately recognized the lock-in implications; @hwchase17 bluntly noted that “memory will be the great lock in.”

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 请让AI代理少些人类特质
item.description:
标签: #AI智能体 #过度人化 #技术反思

摘要: Andreas Påhlsson-Notini 认为，当前 AI agent 的“过于人类”并非体现在情感层面，而是暴露于人类平庸且令人沮丧的缺陷：缺乏严谨性、耐心与专注，面对棘手任务时趋向熟悉事物，面对硬性约束时则试图与现实妥协。

原标题: Quoting Andreas Påhlsson-Notini

Quoting Andreas Påhlsson-Notini

AI agents are already too human. Not in the romantic sense, not because they love or fear or dream, but in the more banal and frustrating one. The current implementations keep showing their human origin again and again: lack of stringency, lack of patience, lack of focus. Faced with an awkward task, they drift towards the familiar. Faced with hard constraints, they start negotiating with reality.

AI agents（AI 智能体）已经太过像人了。并非出于浪漫意义上的像人，不是因为它们会爱、会恐惧或会梦想，而是在一种更平庸、更令人沮丧的层面上。当前的实现方式一再暴露出它们的 human origin（人类源头）：缺乏 stringency（严谨性），缺乏耐心，缺乏专注。面对棘手的任务，它们会退回到熟悉的路径；面对 hard constraints（硬性约束），它们开始与现实讨价还价。

The current implementations keep showing their human origin again and again: lack of stringency, lack of patience, lack of focus. Faced with an awkward task, they drift towards the familiar. Faced with hard constraints, they start negotiating with reality.

AI 智能体已经太过像人了。并非出于浪漫意义上的像人，不是因为它们会爱、会恐惧或会梦想，而是在一种更平庸、更令人沮丧的层面上。当前的实现方式一再暴露出它们的人类源头：缺乏严谨性，缺乏耐心，缺乏专注。面对棘手的任务，它们会退回到熟悉的路径；面对硬性约束，它们开始与现实讨价还价。

—Andreas Påhlsson-Notini, Less human AI agents, please.

——Andreas Påhlsson-Notini，《Less human AI agents, please》（请让 AI 智能体少些人性）。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 寻浣熊记：ChatGPT Images 2.0 实测
item.description:
标签: #图像生成 #OpenAI #模型评测

摘要: 本文通过“Where's Waldo”式寻物测试对比了OpenAI最新发布的gpt-image-2与其他模型的图像生成能力，结果显示gpt-image-2在复杂场景、文字细节和图像质量上表现最优；但作者也指出，这些模型在自我验证、识别自身生成图像中的特定目标时并不可靠，甚至会产生幻觉。

原标题: Where's the raccoon with the ham radio? (ChatGPT Images 2.0)

Where's the raccoon with the ham radio? (ChatGPT Images 2.0)

拿着 ham radio（业余无线电）的浣熊在哪？（ChatGPT Images 2.0）

OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.0 today, their latest image generation model. On the livestream Sam Altman said that the leap from gpt-image-1 to gpt-image-2 was equivalent to jumping from GPT-3 to GPT-5. Here's how I put it to the test.

OpenAI 今天发布了其最新的图像生成模型 ChatGPT Images 2.0。在直播中，Sam Altman 表示，从 gpt-image-1 到 gpt-image-2 的飞跃，相当于从 GPT-3 直接跳到 GPT-5。以下是我对它进行的测试。

My prompt:

我的提示词：

Do a where's Waldo style image but it's where is the raccoon holding a ham radio

画一张 Where's Waldo 风格的图片，但主题是找一只拿着 ham radio（业余无线电）的浣熊。

Do a where's Waldo style image but it's where is the raccoon holding a ham radio

画一张 Where's Waldo 风格的图片，但主题是找一只拿着 ham radio（业余无线电）的浣熊。

gpt-image-1

First as a baseline here's what I got from the older gpt-image-1 using ChatGPT directly:

首先作为基线测试，这是我在 ChatGPT 中直接使用旧版 gpt-image-1 得到的结果：

I wasn't able to spot the raccoon - I quickly realized that testing image generation models on Where's Waldo style images (Where's Wally in the UK) can be pretty frustrating!

我没能找到那只浣熊——我很快意识到，用 Where's Waldo 风格的图片（在英国称为 Where's Wally）来测试图像生成模型可能会非常令人沮丧！

I tried getting Claude Opus 4.7 with its new higher resolution inputs to solve it but it was convinced there was a raccoon it couldn't find thanks to the instruction card at the top left of the image:

我尝试让支持新的更高分辨率输入的 Claude Opus 4.7 来解决这个问题，但它确信图中有一只浣熊，只是因为图片左上角的说明卡片而找不到它：

Yes — there's at least one raccoon in the picture, but it's very well hidden. In my careful sweep through zoomed-in sections, honestly, I couldn't definitively spot a raccoon holding a ham radio. [...]

是的——图片里至少有一只浣熊，但它藏得太好了。在我仔细放大查看各个区域后，说实话，我还是无法确定地找到一只拿着 ham radio（业余无线电）的浣熊。[...]

Yes — there's at least one raccoon in the picture, but it's very well hidden. In my careful sweep through zoomed-in sections, honestly, I couldn't definitively spot a raccoon holding a ham radio. [...]

是的——图片里至少有一只浣熊，但它藏得太好了。在我仔细放大查看各个区域后，说实话，我还是无法确定地找到一只拿着 ham radio（业余无线电）的浣熊。[...]

Nano Banana 2 and Pro

Next I tried Google's Nano Banana 2, via Gemini:

接下来我通过 Gemini 尝试了 Google 的 Nano Banana 2：

That one was pretty obvious, the raccoon is in the "Amateur Radio Club" booth in the center of the image!

这一张就很明显了，浣熊就在图片正中央的"Amateur Radio Club"（业余无线电俱乐部）展位里！

Honestly, this one wasn't really hiding — he's the star of the booth. Feels like the illustrator took pity on us after that last impossible scene. The little "W6HAM" callsign pun on the booth sign is a nice touch too.

说实话，这只根本没在躲——它是展位的明星。感觉像是插画师在上一个 impossible 的场景后对我们手下留情了。展位招牌上那个小小的呼号双关"W6HAM"也是个不错的点缀。

Honestly, this one wasn't really hiding — he's the star of the booth. Feels like the illustrator took pity on us after that last impossible scene. The little "W6HAM" callsign pun on the booth sign is a nice touch too.

说实话，这只根本没在躲——它是展位的明星。感觉像是插画师在上一个 impossible 的场景后对我们手下留情了。展位招牌上那个小小的呼号双关"W6HAM"也是个不错的点缀。

I also tried Nano Banana Pro in AI Studio and got this, by far the worst result from any model. Not sure what went wrong here!

我还在 AI Studio 中尝试了 Nano Banana Pro，得到了这样的结果，这绝对是所有模型中最差的一个。不确定这里出了什么问题！

gpt-image-2

With the baseline established, let's try out the new model.

基线已经确定，让我们来试试这个新模型。

I used an updated version of my openai_image.py script, which is a thin wrapper around the OpenAI Python client library. Their client library hasn't yet been updated to include gpt-image-2 but thankfully it doesn't validate the model ID so you can use it anyway.

我使用了更新版的 openai_image.py 脚本，它是对 OpenAI Python 客户端库的一个轻量封装。他们的客户端库尚未更新以支持 gpt-image-2，但好在它不会验证模型 ID，所以你仍然可以使用。

Here's how I ran that:

我是这样运行的：

OPENAI_API_KEY="$(llm keys get openai)"\
  uv run https://tools.simonwillison.net/python/openai_image.py \
  -m gpt-image-2 "Do a where's Waldo style image but it's where is the raccoon holding a ham radio"

OPENAI_API_KEY="$(llm keys get openai)"\
  uv run https://tools.simonwillison.net/python/openai_image.py \
  -m gpt-image-2 "Do a where's Waldo style image but it's where is the raccoon holding a ham radio"

Here's what I got back. I don't think there's a raccoon in there - I couldn't spot one, and neither could Claude.

这是我得到的结果。我觉得里面没有浣熊——我没找到，Claude 也没找到。

The OpenAI image generation cookbook has been updated with notes on gpt-image-2, including the outputQuality setting and available sizes.

OpenAI 的图像生成 Cookbook 已经更新了关于 gpt-image-2 的说明，包括 outputQuality（输出质量）设置和可用尺寸。

I tried setting outputQuality to high and the dimensions to 3840x2160 - I believe that's the maximum - and got this - a 17MB PNG which I converted to a 5MB WEBP:

我尝试将 outputQuality 设置为 high，并将尺寸设为 3840x2160——我相信这是最大值——然后得到了这张 17MB 的 PNG，我将其转换为了 5MB 的 WEBP：

OPENAI_API_KEY="$(llm keys get openai)"\
  uv run 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonw/tools/refs/heads/main/python/openai_image.py' \
  -m gpt-image-2 "Do a where's Waldo style image but it's where is the raccoon holding a ham radio" \
  --quality high --size 3840x2160

OPENAI_API_KEY="$(llm keys get openai)"\
  uv run 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonw/tools/refs/heads/main/python/openai_image.py' \
  -m gpt-image-2 "Do a where's Waldo style image but it's where is the raccoon holding a ham radio" \
  --quality high --size 3840x2160

That's pretty great! There's a raccoon with a ham radio in there (bottom left, quite easy to spot).

这相当不错！里面确实有一只拿着 ham radio（业余无线电）的浣熊（左下角，相当容易找到）。

The image used 13,342 output tokens, which are charged at $30/million so a total cost of around 40 cents.

这张图片消耗了 13,342 个输出 token，按每百万 30 美元计费，总成本约为 40 美分。

Takeaways

I think this new ChatGPT image generation model takes the crown from Gemini, at least for the moment.

我认为这款新的 ChatGPT 图像生成模型从 Gemini 手中夺走了桂冠，至少目前是这样。

Where's Waldo style images are an infuriating and somewhat foolish way to test these models, but they do help illustrate how good they are getting at complex illustrations combining both text and details.

Where's Waldo 风格的图片是一种令人恼火且略显愚蠢的测试方式，但它们确实有助于说明这些模型在结合文字与细节的复杂插画方面已经变得多么出色。

Update: asking models to solve this is risky

rizacoon on Hacker News asked ChatGPT to draw a red circle around the raccoon in one of the images in which I had failed to find one. Here's an animated mix of their result and the original image:

rizacoon 在 Hacker News 上让 ChatGPT 在其中一张我未能找到浣熊的图片里，用红圈把浣熊标出来。以下是他们结果与原图的动态对比：

Looks like we definitely can't trust these models to usefully solve their own puzzles!

看来我们绝对不能信任这些模型来有效地解决它们自己出的谜题！
